summary: End-to-end vertical slice (gate G4) implemented and executed: the elementwise operator ops/suite/dev/absolute_kernel.py compiles through every stage (AST frontend -> specialization identity -> verified TIR -> provenance-checked 1-D grid model with compile-time equality self-check -> execution plan -> verified MIR -> legalisation -> table-driven selection -> interference-based allocation with spill/split -> complete program-level assembly -> cross as+ld+precompiled runtime) into one ELF64 little-endian RISC-V executable that runs under the declared QEMU endpoint through the a100_support native device protocol and compares bit-exact against the case's expected outputs at threads 1/2/4/8 on ONE artifact per compile identity. Slice operator: out=|x| over a 128-element block with masked ragged tails. All 9 declared test commands exit 0, including the ragged-tail witness (degraded build corrupts a poisoned guard region; real build keeps it intact). Two probe-found bugs were fixed during the work: (1) branch-argument moves for the not-taken edge read registers clobbered by the taken edge's cycle-breaking (fixed with per-edge move stubs after the condition is read); (2) fp arith.mul selected the integer vmul.vv row (fixed by splitting fp/int repertoire rows; the earlier pass was accidental - the -0.0 divergence hid inside the tolerance).

With the predicate removed in a scratch build (compile option witness_drop_tail_predicates, a separate artifact identity 8fb298d15e21): the ragged case FAILS -- tail lanes corrupt the guard (bytes 00000080 27f6523f... != 5a5a5ada...). The witness fails as required; the tool exits nonzero if either condition is violated (the check can fail).

The MIR verifier rejects hand-built malformed modules, one per invariant class: vsetvli-region inconsistency (v64m1 op in an e32m1 region; and a vector op outside any region), masked store without inactive semantics (and a store declaring 'undef', and a masked load without a declared default), use-before-definition (in-block and cross-block), plus the v0-mask constraint, block-structure and type/unknown-op classes; and it accepts the lowering's real output for the slice operator (pre- and post-legalisation).
